cell_line: Both HEK293T (ATCC), and HT1080 (ATCC) were cultured in Dulbecco’s modified Eagle’s Medium (DMEM, Life Technologies) supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum, 2 mM L-glutamine and penicillin–streptomycin (Life Technologies).
material_type: Nuclear extract was prepared by lysing cells in hypotonic buffer and salt extraction of nuclei.
species: For stable isotope labeling, Hela cells were cultured in DMEM medium for SILAC (Thermo fisher, cat # 88364) supplemented with 10% dialyzed FBS (Sigma, F0392) and stable isotope labeled lysine and arginine (light: 12 C and 14 N; heavy: 13 C and 15 N; 50 mg each for 500 mL medium).
strain: GST-tagged recombinant proteins are expressed in E. coli BL21 strain at 16 °C for 20 hours in the presence of 0.1 mM IPTG (Sigma), purified with glutathione sepharose (GE Healthcare) in protein lysis buffer (50 mM Tris-HCl pH8.0, 150 mM NaCl, 0.1% Nonidet P-40, 0.5 mM PMSF) and eluted with 10 mg/mL reduced glutathione (Sigma) in 100 mM Tris-HCl (pH 8.0).
